fingerprint: SHA-256 of canonical UTF-8 JSON of the complete immutable intent excluding fingerprint; cross-language vectors required
unknownPolicy: Attempted writes query original ID only. Absent/mismatched epoch/version is not confirmation and never causes an automatic resend or new registration ID. Old v1 unknown remains unchanged.
revocationPolicy: A separately authorized explicit off intent may reserve a higher generation and persistent absent-device/v1-write tombstone. It never rewrites the old unknown receipt.
feedPolicy: Stable persisted epoch/order/high-water pages; every scanned original and result durable before cursor advance; no silent floor/epoch/overflow/out-of-order reset
resetPolicy: Separate immutable feed-reset intent binds durable gap acceptance; bounded original snapshot, no clearing P7 or unknown receipts, no claim to recover pruned history
diskCompatibility: Read old v1; activate v2 with atomic device/receipt/fence state and old-writer-rejecting disk version. V1 wire remains for non-adopted devices.
